li.p: Press the EV button to the OFF position and turn all other switches off.
Pull the suspected fuse straight out. Use the removal tool provided in the fuse panel cover.
Check the removed fuse; replace it if it is blown. Spare fuses are provided in the instrument fuse panel (or in the motor compartment fuse panel).
Push in a new fuse of the same rating, and make sure it fits tightly in the clips.

note.p: If the headlights or taillights, stoplights, day time running lights (DRL) do not work and the fuses are OK, consult a professional workshop. Kia recommends visiting an authorized Kia dealer or service partner.
